docs-local.description: Minimum isolated environment for repository /docs verification and harness exercises.
docs-local.networkPolicy: deny-by-default; network is used only by an explicitly invoked workflow or approved tool
docs-local.secretPolicy: no secret values in repository files, prompts, logs, traces, or retained harness evidence
docs-local.cleanup: run-scoped evidence is ignored and may be deleted after its retention or diagnostic need ends

codex-ci.description: Additional commands required by enrolled GitHub Codex workflows.
codex-ci.networkPolicy: workflow-scoped access to GitHub and the configured model provider only
codex-ci.secretPolicy: GitHub and model credentials are injected by the workflow and never persisted as evidence
codex-ci.cleanup: ephemeral runner teardown plus explicit artifact retention policy
